caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped box with a fitted lid, positioned centrally against a plain, light background. The box is predominantly blue in color, with a textured appearance suggesting a material like decorated tin or cardboard. Both the sides and the top of the box are adorned with floral patterns featuring large, pale pink flowers with green leaves and stems. There are white decorative lines and swirls accenting the lid and upper portion of the box, outlining sections of the box and highlighting the floral design. The bottom edge of the box is slightly uneven, and the overall coloration includes subtle variations in the blue, giving a sense of depth and shadow. There is no visible text or secondary objects aside from the box itself.
title: Bandbox
